messages:
julian: FYI - canary perf alert after the merge that landed last night. p95 decode up ~25% on short-seq workloads. traces point at attention kernel switching for ~30% of requests and KV cache miss rate jumping.
deploy-bot: Canary check failed: perf/p95 > threshold (+24%). Rollout paused automatically.
anya: Ack. Reproduced locally with the shortseq perf harness. If I force the old kernel we don't see the spike.
michael: What heuristics changed? I scanned the PR and saw the kernel selector logic tweak around sequence fingerprinting.
julian: Right — commit 3f8a9b2 altered the kernel selection boundary when seq_len<64 to pick matmul-attn-v2 for supposed better packing. But the selector is using the wrong memory stride in the prefetch math (index offset bug) so many short seqs end up with a misaligned path.
anya: Minimal repro steps I used:
```
# shortseq repro
python perf_harness.py --model gpt-medium --seq-len 24 --batch 4 --iters 1000
# switch kernel
export KERNEL_FORCE=matmul-attn-v2
```
profiling snippet:
```
attn_kernel: matmul-attn-v2  -> avg_lat 3.4ms (expected 1.8ms)
kv_cache_miss_rate: 0.37 -> baseline 0.05
```
anya: Looks like the misalignment causes extra memcopy / slower matmul path, and KV hotset thrashes the cache.
karen: Can we bisect to confirm 3f8a9b2 as the culprit? If confirmed we should revert the selector change and re-roll.
michael: I'm running a binary bisect on canary cluster now (roughly 10 mins per step). Will ping with the first failing revision.
julian: Thanks. Attaching a short perf flame snapshot and the selector snippet where the offset math lives.
rachel: Also saw more GPU PCIe traffic in the canary trace; aligns with extra memcopies.
sre_bot: Alert: rollout is on hold. Manual approval required to continue.
michael: Bisect result: first bad commit 3f8a9b2 -> selector picks v2 when (seq_hash & 0xff) < 40. Reverting that single condition fixes the shortseq p95 back to baseline.
julian: Confirmed: revert candidate reduces p95 by ~22% in canary. I propose a narrow hotfix reverting the heuristic and follow-up to fix offset math.
karen: +1 on narrow revert. Add an integration test in the kernel selector harness to catch this pattern.
anya: I'll open PR for revert and add a unit test that exercises seq_len<64 with varying strides.
michael: I'll keep the bisect notes and attach trace diffs to the PR.
julian: For postmortem: root cause = selector heuristic change + index offset bug exposing memcopy heavy path -> KV cache thrash -> decode tail p95 spike. Mitigation = revert + test + fix index math.
rachel: Thx. Also adding an observation to the perf dashboard to alert on sudden KV miss rate deltas for shortseq traffic.
karen: Sounds good. Once revert PR merges we'll unhold rollout and re-run canary.
julian: Pushing the PR in ~15m. Thanks all :thumbsup:
